key_insight: The paper argues that multiple disciplinary frameworks are converging on a unified concept of 'physical AI' — systems that not only model or reason about the world but physically act within it, requiring embodiment, material constraints, control, and situated learning. It reframes intelligent behavior as an integration of sensing, physical interaction, and continual adaptation rather than purely symbolic or simulated cognition.
problem_solved: Clarifies and synthesizes what it takes for agents to move from prediction/simulation to robust, real-world physical action by identifying core components, gaps, and a research roadmap across disciplines.
method: Survey and synthesize cross-disciplinary frameworks (robotics, cognitive science, materials, control, ML) to extract common requirements for physical agency.
Propose a conceptual taxonomy and research agenda that links embodiment, physical dynamics, learning, and evaluation (benchmarks/metrics) for Physical AI.
Recommend integration strategies: co-design of morphology, sensing, control and learning pipelines, and realistic testbeds for closed-loop physical evaluation.
impact: Provides AI/ML practitioners a practical, interdisciplinary roadmap for building agents that work in the real world, highlighting the need to account for physical constraints, embodiment and end-to-end evaluation. Adopting these principles can accelerate robust robot learning, safer deployment, and more useful embodied systems.
visual_elements: Concept map showing convergence of disciplines (robotics, materials, control, ML, cognitive science) into 'Physical AI'.
Pipeline diagram of perception → prediction/modeling → control → physical interaction → adaptation (closed loop).
Taxonomy graphic listing core components (embodiment, morphology, sensing, dynamics, learning, benchmarks) with brief priorities.
Comparative chart contrasting traditional 'simulative/symbolic AI' vs 'physical/embodied AI' along evaluation, robustness, and real-world readiness axes.
paper_title: From embodied intelligence to physical AI
